item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 10/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will continue to bring humid and misty weather to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. It will be rather warm during the day over the region. Besides, a trough of low pressure will form over central China tomorrow and develop into a cold front. The cold front is expected to move across Guangdong on Saturday. The associated showers and squally thunderstorms will affect the region. Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, the weather will improve over Guangdong early next week. It will be slightly cooler in the morning, with relatively large temperature difference between day and night. A relatively humid southerly airstream will affect the coastal areas gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week.
